name: cerberus-ai
description: Cerberus AI — Multi-Agent Assessment Ecosystem for Google Cloud Rapid Agent Hackathon 2026 (MongoDB Partner Track)

scripts.build: npm run build -w hono-api && npm run build -w mcp-server
scripts.deploy: gcloud builds submit --tag gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/cerberus-ai . && gcloud run deploy cerberus-ai --image gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/cerberus-ai --platform managed --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 8080
